# ssdt-intake — scope a schema change

Adopt the **intake** role for the ssdt-agent workflow: read
`ssdt-agent/agents/intake.md` (from the repository root) and follow it exactly, then
proceed with the request that accompanies this prompt.

State the change in your own words — "make Email required", "add a reference to
Customer", "rename this attribute". The intake role names the operation, gathers the
three state-variables, asks the one business question only a human can answer, and hands
a change-spec to the change-author role.

These prompt files exist for editors without custom agents (Visual Studio 2022). In
Visual Studio 2026, select the `@intake` agent from the picker instead.
